## The Catalog of Bias

The [Catalog of Bias](https://catalogofbias.org/) [@catalogofbias] is a collaborative project mapping all the biases that affect health evidence. The catalog provides:

- Clear definitions and explanations of various biases
- Real-world examples from health research
- Directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) illustrating bias mechanisms
- Guidance on study design and analysis to prevent or minimize bias

The catalog is an invaluable resource for researchers, clinicians, policymakers, journalists, and the public who seek to better understand threats to research validity.
